remarks: Stamford's best private and sought after community living at its finest! Mid city and walk to houses of worship. Bright and Airy 3 level home. Amazing location! Open concept living room and dining / living room areas, with sliders to private patio. High ceilings, updated kitchen, upgraded + Smart Lighting (Google devices) throughout the house. Nest Thermostat and smart locks! Gorgeous and Large Primary bedroom with attached bathroom. Step out from your primary into your private Large Deck that spans both bedrooms. Stainless Steel appliances + Quartz countertops + bay window completes the wonderful and Bright Kitchen. Recessed lights throughout! Double closets and plenty of storage space throughout the home. Large windows and Skylights bring in light from every direction! Secret additional playroom/office/study. Plus very large loft area that can be another office/bedroom/flex space. Lots of Upgrades throughout!! Renovated Kitchen & Bathroom (2022), New Hot Water heater (2024), washer/dryer (2022), Microwave (2022),Central HVAC (2018) and much more. Immaculate and well manicured 19 acre grounds + Lovely club House + In Ground Swimming Pool. Attached Garage, but also plenty of parking for visitors! This location is located on a cut-de-sac! HIGHEST AND BEST by 3pm Monday 5/5/25
